newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile supermarket chain Unimarc plans ADRs.
newsitem.headline: Chile supermarket chain Unimarc plans ADRs.

text.p: Chilean supermarket group Supermercados Unimarc SA said its shareholders have agreed a capital increase, part of which will be raised from foreign investors directly or via American Depositary Receipts.
The firm's shareholders agreed a capital increase of 51.25 billion pesos, around $122 million, at a meeting last month, said the company in a statement to the Chilean SEC.
The new shares will be offered first to existing shareholders and those which are not bought will be sold to local and international investors, said the statement.
